{{translated title}} ---- [[File:Welcome Pokémon Café PikaVee Mixing à la mode art.png|thumb|250px|Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode]] (Japanese: '''{{j|ようこそ！ポケモンカフェ　ピカブイのまぜまぜアラモード}}''' ''Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode'') is a colored {{pkmn|manga}} written by {{j|すずきさなえ}} Sanae Suzuki and illustrated by {{j|ふじのきともこ}} Tomoko Fujinoki. It is the sequel of [[Pocket Monsters: PikaVee's Soothing DAYS]]. It is based on {{g|Café ReMix}}. It was serialized in the ''{{wp|Pucchigumi}}'' magazine as (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカフェ　ミックス　ピカブイのくるくる{{ruby|ＤＡＹＳ|デイズ}}}}''' ''Pokémon Café Mix: PikaVee's Spinning DAYS'') from the January 2021 issue (released on December 1, 2020) to the November 2021 issue (released on October 1, 2021) and is serialized as (Japanese: '''{{j|ようこそ！ポケモンカフェ　ピカブイのまぜまぜアラモード}}''' ''Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode'') since the December 2021 issue (released on November 1, 2021). While the first volume isn't titled or numbered, the second volume is titled (Japanese: '''{{j|～わいわいクッキング！～}}''' ''~Cheerful Cooking!~'') and the third volume is titled (Japanese: '''{{j|～きらきらクッキング！～}}''' ''~Sparkly Cooking!~''). It was announced in the December 2020 issue of ''Pucchigumi'', released on October 30, 2020.[https://web.archive.org/web/20201124034700/https://pucchigumi.net/newest/1413.html ''Pucchigumi'' December 2020 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archived)[https://twitter.com/okahijiki/status/1327869138765680640 Tomoko Fujinoki about the ''Pucchigumi'' December 2020 issue on X (Twitter)] ==Volumes== {| class="roundtable c" style="margin:auto; background:#{{colorschemelight|LGPE}}; border:2px solid #{{colorschemedark|LGPE}}" !
